name: io.github.nelprofessional/nel-veil
description: Free passive security scanning for AI agents. Check any domain for email spoofing (DMARC/SPF/DKIM), TLS and certificate expiry, HTTP security headers, publicly exposed files, and subdomain-takeover risk — using public DNS and ordinary HTTP requests only. No port scanning, no exploit testing, no API key required.

environmentVariables.name: NEL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the NEL VEIL API base URL. Only needed for local development against a self-hosted backend; leave unset to use the public API at https://api.nelprofessional.com.
